novel_policies.label: arbitration clause allowed
novel_policies.quote: Nothing in this act shall preclude the court from setting aside an arbitration clause on any basis permitted under Pennsylvania law.

novel_policies.label: change order must be written
novel_policies.quote: Deviate from or disregard plans or specifications, in any material respect, without a written change order dated and signed by both the contractor and owner

novel_policies.label: contract must be written
novel_policies.quote: No home improvement contract shall be valid or enforceable against an owner unless it: Is in writing and legible

novel_policies.label: deposit cap contract threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: for a home improvement contract in which the total price is more than $5,000

novel_policies.label: deposit cap fraction
novel_policies.quote: for a home improvement contract in which the total price is more than $5,000, receive a deposit in excess of one-third of the home improvement contract price

novel_policies.label: enhanced penalty for elderly victims
novel_policies.quote: Where a person commits an offense under subsection (a) and the victim is 60 years of age or older, the grading of the offense shall be one grade higher

novel_policies.label: fraud felony threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: a felony of the third degree if the amount involved exceeds $2,000

novel_policies.label: fraud offense defined
novel_policies.quote: A person commits the offense of home improvement fraud if, with intent to defraud or injure anyone or with knowledge that he is facilitating a fraud or injury to be perpetrated by anyone

novel_policies.label: insurance personal injury minimum usd
novel_policies.quote: proof of liability insurance covering personal injury in an amount not less than $50,000

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd
novel_policies.quote: insurance covering property damage caused by the work of a home improvement contractor in an amount not less than $50,000

novel_policies.label: does not require bonding
novel_policies.quote: the board may, at its discretion, require any contractor who has had action taken against his/her registration to obtain a bond in such amount as determined by the board

novel_policies.label: degree level: bachelor
novel_policies.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction

novel_policies.label: degree level: high school
novel_policies.quote: Possesses a high school diploma or a High School Equivalency Diploma

novel_policies.label: does not require moral character
novel_policies.quote: no specialty section of the board shall adopt, maintain, renew, or enforce any rule, or otherwise preclude in any way, an individual from renewing a license under this chapter due to any past criminal activity or interpretation of moral character.

novel_policies.label: lacks scope protection
novel_policies.quote: A contractor who is not registered with the director as required by this chapter shall not be awarded a contract to perform work for the state or an agency of the state.

novel_policies.label: local trade licensing preserved
novel_policies.quote: This provision does not affect existing licensing standards in effect on the effective date of this act, with respect to electricians and plumbers and other trades, where licensing is conditioned on requirements of testing or possession of certificates obtained through specific training in electricity or plumbing or other trades.

novel_policies.label: minimum annual revenue threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: A person for whom the total cash value of all of that person's home improvements is less than $5,000 during the previous taxable year.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd
novel_policies.quote: the total cash price of all work agreed upon between the contractor and owner is more than $500

novel_policies.label: out of state disciplinary action reporting required
novel_policies.quote: Any disciplinary action taken in such other jurisdiction shall be reported to the bureau on the initial registration application or, if such action occurred subsequent to submission of an initial application, on the biennial registration application or within 90 days of final disposition, whichever is sooner.

novel_policies.label: insurance personal injury minimum usd: 1000000
novel_policies.quote: A person registered under this chapter shall maintain minimum liability insurance coverage in the amount of $1,000,000.00 per occurrence and $2,000,000.00 aggregate

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd: 20000
novel_policies.quote: public liability and property damage insurance covering the applicant's contracting operations in this state in the sum of not less than $20,000 for damage to property

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd: 300000
novel_policies.quote: property damage insurance in an amount not less than three hundred thousand dollars ($300,000)

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd: 25000
novel_policies.quote: property damage insurance with limits of at least $25,000 or a policy with a single limit for bodily injury and property damage of $300,000 per occurrence and $300,000 aggregate limits

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd: 500000
novel_policies.quote: not less than the following amount: five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) combined single limit, bodily injury and property damage

novel_policies.label: minimum annual revenue threshold usd: 2000
novel_policies.quote: a person who earns less than two thousand dollars annually or who performs work or has work performed on the person's own property is not a contractor for purposes of this chapter.

novel_policies.label: minimum annual revenue threshold usd: 15000
novel_policies.quote: a person whose total gross annual receipts for performing specialty skills for which licensure would be required under this section do not exceed $15,000

novel_policies.label: minimum annual revenue threshold usd: 7200
novel_policies.quote: an individual who works on one undertaking or project at a time that, in the aggregate or singly, does not exceed seven thousand two hundred dollars ($7,200) compensation a year, the work being casual, minor or inconsequential, such as handyman repairs

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 100000
novel_policies.quote: where the cost of the undertaking is one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) or more

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 1500
novel_policies.quote: Any project or operation for which the aggregate contract price for labor and materials is not more than $1,500.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 2000
novel_policies.quote: A person performing work on one (1) undertaking or project considered casual, minor, or inconsequential, whether by one (1) or more contracts, the aggregate contract price of which, for labor and materials and all other items, is less than two thousand dollars ($2,000).

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 7500
novel_policies.quote: Any improvements or repairs to an existing residential structure for which the project value is seven thousand five hundred dollars or more.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 40000
novel_policies.quote: the construction of any building, highway, public utilities, grading or any improvement or structure where the cost of the undertaking is forty thousand dollars ($40,000) or more

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 4000
novel_policies.quote: A person may not engage in the business nor act in the capacity of a contractor within this state when the cost, value, or price per job exceeds the sum of four thousand dollars

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 25000
novel_policies.quote: "Contractor" means any person or entity that undertakes to, attempts to or submits a price or bid or offers to construct ... any other construction undertaking for which the total cost is twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) or more

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 7000
novel_policies.quote: a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials, and including all changes or additions to the contracted or agreed upon work

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 5000
novel_policies.quote: where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work

novel_policies.label: right of rescission days: 10
novel_policies.quote: A residential property owner may cancel a contract to replace or repair a roof without penalty or obligation within 10 days after the execution of the contract or by the official start date, whichever comes first

novel_policies.label: right of rescission days: 1
novel_policies.quote: A property owner who enters into an initial written contract for the construction, improvement or repair of a residential structure or zero-lot-line dwelling on real property owned by the property owner may cancel the contract by delivery of a written notice of cancellation anytime prior to 12 midnight at the end of the next business day.

novel_policies.label: lacks state preempts local registration fees
novel_policies.quote: Except as to contractors currently licensed under the provisions of § 54.1-1106, any locality shall have the power and authority to adopt ordinances, not inconsistent with the provisions of this chapter, requiring every person who engages in, or offers to engage in, the business of home improvement or the business of constructing single-family or multi-family dwellings, in such locality, to obtain a license from such locality.

novel_policies.label: registration number required in ads
novel_policies.quote: A contractor shall include its registration number in all advertisements distributed within this Commonwealth and on all contracts, estimates and proposals with owners in this Commonwealth.

novel_policies.label: registration renewal interval years
novel_policies.quote: Any registered contractor in this Commonwealth who is registered or licensed as a home improvement contractor in any other state, or political subdivision thereof, shall report this information to the bureau on the initial registration and biennial registration application.

novel_policies.label: right of rescission days
novel_policies.quote: shall be permitted to rescind the contract without penalty regardless of where the contract was signed, within three business days of the date of signing

novel_policies.label: self insurance permitted
novel_policies.quote: proof of insurance may include information attested to by an applicant that the applicant is self-insured and the bureau shall develop forms for this purpose

novel_policies.label: state preempts local registration fees
novel_policies.quote: Registration under this act shall preclude any requirement of payment of a fee or registration or licensing of any home improvement contractor by any political subdivision.

novel_policies.label: voidable contract clauses
novel_policies.quote: If a home improvement contract contains any of the following clauses, the home improvement contract shall be voidable by the owner: A hold harmless clause. A waiver of Federal, State or local health, life, safety or building code requirements. A confession of judgment clause.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 50000
novel_policies.quote: when the cost of the work to be done, or done, in the State of Arkansas by the contractor, including, but not limited to, labor and materials, is fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) or more.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 2500
novel_policies.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 10000
novel_policies.quote: No entity or individual may practice as a contractor by performing or offering to perform contracting work for which the total cost of construction is greater than ten thousand dollars for general contracting or greater than ten thousand dollars for mechanical contracting without a license issued in accordance with this chapter.

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: Each licensing board may require and issue rules for continuing education requirements as a condition to license renewal.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd: 500
novel_policies.quote: any contractor or subcontractor who works on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts where the aggregate contract price is less than five hundred dollars

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There is created the Residential Contractors Committee, to consist of seven (7) members.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: The governor shall appoint a registrar of contractors pursuant to section 38-211. The registrar shall serve at the pleasure of the governor. The registrar is vested with all functions and duties relating to administration of this chapter.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a shared board
novel_policies.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Contractors State License Board, which consists of 15 members.

novel_policies.label: lacks title protection
novel_policies.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director and shall meet all of the following requirements as a condition of registration
